title: Living world plants (data/livingworld/plants.yaml)
description: Map items that react when a creature walks on or next to them, and how they take the wind (livingworld/README.md). Cosmetic: the server never reads it.

reaction.description: What a passing creature does to it. Absent: by its wind type (trees rustle, the rest bend); none with wind: none.

trample.description: On a tile worn into a path (trail wear) it is drawn flattened.

wind.description: How it takes the wind. Absent: what its sprite says (data/livingworld/wind_sprites.yaml). A plant type: that type's defaults (wind.yaml kinds). A mapping: a type with its own numbers. none: it never sways (say why in a comment).
